earlier_issuances.narrative_markdown:
## Overview
Slightly cooler and cloudier than yesterday; winds little changed. Largely dry, with thunder possible from the morning, peaking overnight. Temperatures and winds much the same through Friday, with showers and thunderstorms likely each day.

## Today's Forecast
Evening showers and thunderstorms are expected across Kisumu, with daytime temperatures reaching a high of 29.5°C / 85°F and overnight lows dropping to 19.0°C / 66°F. Skies will remain overcast to mostly cloudy through most of the day as cloud cover remains heavy across all models. Peak surface wind gusts ashore will reach 37.5 km/h (20 kt). Peak solar UV exposure will reach a maximum index of 9.4 around midday. All local ground air quality sensors are currently stale, but CAMS model data indicates moderate air quality with an AQI around 70.

## Extended Outlook
Over the next three days through Friday, temperatures remain steady with daytime highs in the range of 28°C to 32°C / 82°F to 90°F and overnight lows near 18°C to 22°C / 64°F to 72°F. Showers and thunderstorms are likely each day, particularly during late afternoon and evening hours. Cloud cover will vary between partly cloudy and overcast. Looking ahead to days 4 through 7 (Saturday through Tuesday), lower confidence guidance points to continued daily rain potential, peaking early next week with highs ranging from 25°C / 77°F to 35°C / 95°F depending on model resolution.

## Severe Weather / Hazard Potential
Convective instability is significant today, with peak CAPE values ranging from 580 J/kg in GFS up to 3600 J/kg in UKMO and 3660 J/kg in Best Match. Thunderstorms are possible from late morning, with peak activity anticipated overnight. Any developing thunderstorm can generate localized, sudden, and violent wind gusts well above the background forecast winds. These convective downdraft gusts pose a distinct hazard independent of daily sustained wind speeds.

## Winam Gulf — Conditions for Boaters
For mariners on Winam Gulf, winds will move overnight at 8 km/h (4 kt) gusting 9 km/h (5 kt), then south-southwesterly by midday at 7 km/h (4 kt) gusting 17 km/h (9 kt), then into the evening at 9 km/h (5 kt) gusting 19 km/h (10 kt). Peak secondary gusts on the water are expected to reach 28.1 km/h (15 kt). Boaters should remain cautious as evening thunderstorms over the lake can trigger sudden, severe wind shifts and high localized waves.

## Detailed Discussion
### Synoptic Overview
Across roughly 2,600 km, pressure is lowest toward the north (1008 hPa) and highest toward the southeast (1017 hPa) — an 8 hPa spread, a moderate large-scale gradient. The lower pressure to the north is filling over the next three days. Pressure overhead is near-steady. Regionally across the Nyanza Basin, mean sea level pressure remains around 1012.6 hPa with mild 24-hour trends (+0.5 hPa). Moisture pooling and daytime surface heating combined with regional low pressure to the north support continued convective development.

### Forecaster Confidence Notes
The multi-model guidance behind this forecast is at least 9.0 hours old, having last aligned at 18:00Z. Model track record evaluations at Day+0 show ICON as the most reliable rain caller in the basin, while GFS remains the weakest. Best Match and calibrated peak gust algorithms were prioritized for surface wind estimates due to systematic under-forecasting of gusts across uncorrected numerical models.

The local met service, Kenya Meteorological Department (KMD), forecasts a high of 28.0°C / 82°F and a low of 21.0°C / 70°F for Kisumu today, calling for light morning rains, sunny intervals, and afternoon/evening moderate showers and thunderstorms. This aligns well with the numerical consensus and forecaster call, though our forecast expects a slightly higher daytime peak near 29.5°C / 85°F.

Regarding ground air quality stations, all three local sensors reported stale data (4 hours old): Kisumu Airport (A418534, PM2.5 52.0 µg/m³), Ochieng' Avenue (A418300, PM2.5 42.0 µg/m³), and Dunga Beach (A418504, PM2.5 52.0 µg/m³). Because no fresh numeric ground AQI was reported, air quality characterization relies on CAMS model guidance.
